title: 故乡
status: H3 空景短测中：镜01贴地推进，不演天空
coreStatement: 写给身在故乡的人：由沙哑男中低音讲述被叫着小王的人走在泥路和田埂上，被云、草、庄稼带回小时候，却发现那些场景一去不复返，并记住‘回得了故乡，走不进那天’。

metadata.genre: 沙哑男中低音慢唱叙事民谣
metadata.vocal: 成年男声，沙哑男中低音，不要太低沉；尾音、窄颤音、少量转音滑音；断句换气跟编曲走

prompts.label: Mureka 专属风格提示词（513 字符）
prompts.zh: Mandarin husky mid-low baritone slow story-folk，52 BPM，4/4拍，A小调，极慢、叙事。男声用沙哑的男中低音演唱，不要太低沉；干、近、带沙，唱得更好听。沙哑但不破音、不嘶吼。不要男低音、男高音、少年音、女声、气声甜歌。歌词节拍慢，字少拍多，不要赶词说唱。断句、换气跟编曲走，不要按字硬切。主唱后于拍点。必须有尾音、窄颤音、少量转音和滑音：句尾把字送完再收；长音后半加颤；「故乡」「那天」可轻转；不要念白，不要密集跑音。磨损钢弦木吉他拇指慢拨，低音贝斯，刷子极轻，可加暗大提琴；钢琴很少或不用。前奏8小节必须先抓住人：一声空弦后，高把位弹出「走不进那天」的吉他动机，留白再反复，后4小节才落到慢拨；不要标题人声，不要闷头陪衬。有人还叫他小王，院门还开着。「回得了」的「了」读三声 liǎo，不要轻声。“回得了，故乡”唱开，尾音带颤；“走不进那天”按编曲换气，天拉长轻转再收，不要压低也不要往上送。点点滴滴可轻转。桥段更慢。最终副歌更满但不加速、不转调、不冲顶。避免过低沉男低音、薄亮嗓、假声、赶词、硬切句、密集跑音、说唱、明亮民谣、EDM、摇滚鼓、金黄怀旧、歌词出现“农村”。
prompts.en: Mandarin husky mid-low baritone slow story-folk, 52 BPM, 4/4, A minor, very slow and narrative. Male vocal is a husky mid-low baritone, not too deep; dry, close, slightly raspy, and more sung than spoken. Husky but not broken, not shouted. No bass, no bright tenor, no boyish voice, no female vocal, no breathy sweet pop. Slow lyric rhythm: few syllables, many beats; never rush or rap. Phrasing and breaths follow the arrangement; do not chop by written line. Sit behind the beat. Must use trailing endings, narrow late vibrato, sparse turns and slides: finish the vowel before releasing; add vibrato on the second half of long notes; light turns on 故乡 and 那天. No recitation, no dense runs. Worn steel guitar thumb-picked slowly, low bass, light brushes, optional dark cello; little or no piano. Intro must hook in 8 bars: after one open-string ring, a high-register guitar motif quoting “走不进那天”, leave space and repeat; last 4 bars settle into thumb-picking. No sung title, no drab pad-only intro. Someone still calls him 小王; the courtyard gate is still open. Pronounce 了 in 回得了 as third-tone liǎo, not neutral le. Sing “回得了，故乡” openly with a trailing vibrato; phrase “走不进那天” with the arrangement, hold 天, add a light turn, then release—neither dropped too low nor sent high. Light turns on 点点滴滴. Bridge even slower. Final chorus fuller but do not speed up, modulate, or belt. Avoid overly deep bass, thin bright voice, falsetto, rushed diction, rigid line-chopping, dense runs, bright folk-pop, EDM, rock drums, golden nostalgia, and the word 农村.

mvStory.summary: 故乡还在过它的日子。人来人往，也有没人的时候。怀念到处都是，那天谁都走不进去。
mvStory.opening: 先是空田、远山和水。云从田那边过来。故乡先作为农村风景存在，不是城镇。
mvStory.development: 日子被不同的人过：晒粮、洗手、跑过的孩子；也可以切回没人的田。有人还叫小王，院门还开着，应声到嘴边又散了。
mvStory.turningPoint: 同样的地方开始对不上那天。熟路上停几秒，没有人按那天的方式走回去。田埂上风吹过，没有人在等。熟的是活法，生的是时间。
mvStory.climax: 天往下沉时才落下回得了故乡、走不进那天。可以是许多人各自过傍晚，也可以是完全没人的田和路。怀念满了，也只是高兴不起来。
mvStory.ending: 这不是告别。一盏灯亮了，一段路仍黑着。最后停在空田埂或空泥路，云停着。

shots.action: 贴着高低不齐的庄稼沿泥路往田里走。路肩保留车辙、碎土和杂草，旧农舍退到右侧边缘，远山作墙。天空只剩一条空蓝。没有人，没有城镇。

detailed_description:
The target video is photoreal live-action in real time, observed rather than picturesque: late-summer Chinese farmland under soft, low-contrast afternoon daylight. Colors are restrained green, weathered earth and muted blue, with natural dynamic range and no golden nostalgia treatment.
[Shot 1] A 16:9 slightly low medium-wide shot. Mature crop heads fill much of the lower frame, but their heights and spacing are naturally uneven. A narrow packed-earth farm path enters from the lower-left third and leads toward the middle distance instead of dividing the image symmetrically. Two shallow wheel ruts, broken clods of dry earth, sparse verge grass and one small worn patch make the path feel used. Green mountains form a stable wall beyond the fields. Only a thin strip of empty pale-blue sky remains above the ridges. One modest weathered earthen farmhouse is partially visible at the far-right edge, never centered and never presented as a neat housing row. No living person. The camera trucks forward with small amplitude at slow speed along the path. There is no cut.
In the first two seconds the near leaves, ruts and clods already show fine matte surface detail and the slow forward move has begun. The motion feels like a careful human walking pace without bobbing or shaking.
Then only the viewpoint advances. Foreground leaves pass with gentle parallax while the path keeps its off-center course. Crop rows remain irregular rather than becoming a perfect corridor. Mountain ridges retain exactly the same silhouette. The farmhouse keeps straight roof edges, fixed wall proportions and weathered plaster texture. The illumination remains soft and even; soil shadows keep the same direction and length. The narrow sky stays quiet and pale blue.
By the final second the viewer is only a few steps farther into the same field. Crops move no more than a slight natural tremble. Fine leaf veins, dry soil grains, wheel ruts, grass and matte earthen walls remain readable without waxy gloss or over-smoothed surfaces. Stable architecture, stable landforms, coherent crop geometry, restrained realistic color, no living person, no extra limbs, no on-screen text, no logos, no readable Chinese characters.
